title: Customer onboarding call
transcript:
Customer: We are excited about the pilot, but the import workflow is still confusing for our operations team.
Product Lead: The team can simplify the first-run import screen and add a clearer checklist before Friday.
Customer: That would help. We also need confirmation that failed rows can be exported because audit tracking is important.
Solutions Engineer: I will send a sample failed-row export and document the audit fields by tomorrow afternoon.
Product Lead: We should schedule a follow-up review next Tuesday after your team tests the revised import checklist.
Customer: Overall the pilot looks promising, although our team is worried about delays if the audit export is not ready.
